def execute_highwind_limit_final(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Cid calls down multiple missiles from an airship to bombard opponents.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    directions = generate_spread_vectors(aim,count,spread_angle)
    for direction in directions:
        projectile = spawn_owned_projectile(actor,origin,direction)
        projectile.on_swept_collision = lambda hit: resolve_hit_with_hit_ledger(hit)
        destroy_on_impact_range_or_timeout(projectile)
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
